subject: Happy Black History Month
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR
body:
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=122%2E181023%2EAf4VzG)
Team,
Before the month ends, I wanted to take a moment to celebrate Black History Month and acknowledge the contributions of Black Americans to our history and culture.
I started my career in Detroit, clerking for the Honorable Damon J. Keith. Judge Keith who was an incredible leader, a civil rights icon, and an incredible leader throughout his whole life. I was honored to work and learn from him — and be inspired for all that he’s given to our nation.
[](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/239?c0=jmb-em-q12025.B7hgkZ&refcode=AU_JMB_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20250226_AM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=122%2E181023%2EAf4VzG)
All throughout my career, I’ve worked closely with Black Michigan leaders who have helped make this state a great place to live.
From the resilience of the Underground Railroad in Detroit to the artistic achievements of the Motown area, Michigan’s history is *filled* with stories of Black leaders who have shaped our state for the better. I take those lessons to work every single day as I figure out how to save our most vulnerable residents time and money, and protect everyone’s voting rights.
So this month — and every month — I encourage you to learn more about those stories, support Black-owned businesses, and engage in conversations about racial equity.
Our work to realize a more just, fair society is far from over. By understanding our shared history, we can build a more inclusive and just future that works for every Michigander.
Thank you, and Happy Black History Month!
— Jocelyn

**[Could Trump
Dismantle The IRS?](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM1ugzAQBp_G3EB4jW04-NA0Rb1UjaImVXOJHLyAVfNPSMnTV6Ao10-zmtHqqnU2nxWRGwJQWjMQAMJeCMB1ZEd9OHz0s_-2O6F_Y4DLTuD1gU7whOtMT3u8Nrj76obq-_5eSIwm-sTHucUn_JAGWGnrllVuPaMi0DTPPFRURiGPBeeRVypOQ0MvHKWUOo4FBRBaJJIlPGLG5MazCkLgIYCggnJGA0wygyzOLwJMkpmEROEqCvIecSxt_Yu90dbNQdZUnlPlOLbDGpYSSF0baOewsLrOsGicWSgCqe0H3zVNWzYO_cXoj_1ywdJz7awhbLv_M4cOjz-bIwFxrtdfsu29_uzSnncnr1emvVnn7CAkicJibVoSJgX_AQAA___l6nbb)** President Donald Trump has proposed a **historic tax overhaul,** including the **elimination of federal income taxes and the IRS,** replacing them with **tariffs on imports.** In a **January 2025 address,** he stated, _"Instead of taxing our citizens to enrich foreign nations, we should be tariffing and taxing foreign nations to enrich our citizens."_ This proposal aligns with the **Fair Tax Act,** reintroduced by Republican lawmakers, aiming to **[replace income taxes with a national consumption tax.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kE-Lo0AQRz9Ne1O02m710IfNurKX3QlhMgO5hNYqtUn73xjMpx-UkOuPV7xH6aa3plwViw4MoDY4MQDGfzGA-8y_9Pn8b1zdP8cLuQ8OtO0Mfr_QBd5wW-jlRPeOjp_D1Hw__1YRhUvwxue1pzf8knrUaGO3NUodVCHooCwcUkEU-iKWQoROrQSijILC1yEC5lzqPE6iBDgmsRQgc8co8EH4ADKQgeCBR0mBxOMyl4BJgQkL_V3klSPRXJv2RiNqY1ev6BrHqnqe-2kPyxhktve0tVQZ3RZUdRY3ikFmxsm1XdfXnSV3M7rzuF3w7Npag4ynh-F_HZ_kLb0zkNd2_yVPn-3HkI1iuDijwv5hrDWTjFjoV3vTlrAo-AkAAP__KgB25A)** If implemented, this **sweeping change** could have **[major implications](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kF9PgzAURz9NeYPQ21LGQx_USRYTdRqnyV6WQi_QWP4VxmSf3kCWvf5ybs7JVXVnTTFLEj8SgMrogQAQ9kAAziP7VofDq5v95_0R_QsDXHYCTzd0gjvc5Gr6xHOL-69-qH-uuzJGPtE7Ps4d3uGbNMBaGbus8dbTkoOiRe6hpDEPo42IIu5VktMk40ABtRYCFYZMb2gRZ5TzrOBZ6BkJIUQhgKCCRowGmOQa2abIBOgk1wnh4SoKCoc4Vqb5RaeVsXOQt7VnZTWO3bCGpQRS2wXKWiyNanIsW6sXikBq3ODbtu2q1qK_GP3RLRcsPTXWaMK2ffGRvNRv-e6PgDg16y_Z9tq896mL-qPnpO4uxloziJjwsFybloRJwn8AAAD__2t9d2g)** for **401(k), IRA, and TSP** accounts. Here’s how:

**Potential Benefits**
* ✅ **No More Taxes on Withdrawals****\- Traditional IRAs, 401(k)s, and TSPs may no longer be taxed** , allowing retirees to keep 100% of their savings.

* ✅ **Roth IRAs Become More Valuable.**

* ✅ **More Disposable Income for Investing** \- Without income taxes, individuals could have **[more take-home pay](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM1ugzAQBp_G3ECw_gEOPrRNUS9Voyppq1wix17AqvmJIaTk6StQlOunWc1oVdM7W86SpM8EoLZmIACEPhGAy0i_1H7_7ufwdXvA8EoBl53Ayx2d4AG3Wk2feOlwuzsPzfftrUqRTckDH-ceH_BdGmGjrFvWdBMYyUAlpQ5QJimLeSY4Z0EtdQanhBvQLMVTrFIQKuc8N4wh5CLPAishBh4DiEQknCYR5togzcqTAJNrkxMWr6Ko9Ihjbdtf9EZZN0e6awIn63HshzWsIFC4PlLOYWVVq7HqnFkoAoX1Q-i6rq87h-FiDEe_XNDi2DprCN2Im_pRO_pHKQFxbNdf0s2t_TgXnp8PgZemv1rn7CBSwuJqbVoSJgn_AQAA__8A6nab)** , potentially increasing contributions to retirement accounts.

**Potential Negative Impacts**
* ❌ **Uncertainty Around Tax-Deferred Growth and current benefits.**

* ❌ **Consumption Taxes Could Reduce Purchasing Power** \- retirees **[might end up paying more](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kE-rozAURz9N3Cl6Y0xdZDEzrXQzTBleW-imxORGw4v_U4v99A-ldPvjXM7hyqZ31iyC8N8EoLZ6IgCE_iIAD08v8nz-Oy7h4XTD8EkB153Anzc6wwdulZz_46PD09cwNdfXseKYzskH90uPH_gtjbCR1q0r3wdapCATowIUCU9jtssYS4NalCVTJqba5MpwTg0qBMUAc6C8xDIJrIAYWAyQJVnCaBJhrjTSnSkz0LnSOUnjTRSZEdHXtv3GUUvrlkh1TeBE7X0_bWEFgcL1kXQOKytbhVXn9EoRKOw4ha7r-rpzGK7G0I_rBS3urbOa0L2_PIdrWR6aI4Hs3m6_pPtX-28oRjbcglHo_mmds1PGSRpXW9OaMAv4CQAA__8xoHh4)** on purchases, diminishing the benefits of tax-free withdrawals.

* ❌ **Market Volatility & Investment Uncertainty.**

body:
| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.

Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5QCZVvPkKF-QpykRIMPb1IJTyFqSGERjWilgaRWERrXAxxUXNGhqq7wrLc56yjpsCD7ita3tRaOr2ke4Lua5eYvcqC4_xpiSHhaF36wypCGuSrk39psp63mfeOlquBSjGvfuty1kwQfucs9D_fxVExp)

...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5QJHZ9yq6FhwHu1_1LTdKs4TLPcee0HPoWqVYJI3lLMYWQgEXD1Ab8iLAM-y14hV6nsjKum5fJRWdIa1UDC3f30HzJmvx-5nS5OF2bPjw4DkXPQt2pKGKwmDwIoYOVh3gjIvaLctutLHGWWsRTYvOCW)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5Si3kMt6bThgZ7BIldtTRRkhmzrjqo4v5cteZjenAHqgAb5pWo5bMGLOTCCVUC2dD_AExV9OKOefwW5YV9p_D6KyTZsCtzmUdAXBqvWKYEVoR3RG1yKisB95uitnpzggZojg5AlN1xYVa6zgfeSbg6k)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _**[So please, my friend, rush back your gift right away if possible.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5T4uCQpirX_zo_IcJzmhsW1NwiSWzChxvw8emvyoBKKdWzLvq0koOMjCE56Wkar2qgRzw-qtNvBRT0cb_CUPFtIFcPNeIwseU0GF2Blze30MWMx8CSbPXilRs9heCIBk2X6TeS28F-AjU0BJx3oQOdI)**_ With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5QnqASVbxMYBFtbkcZ_6NVk0pgZeGQnOgg6cgcv9NiAFwq9-aYppavf41FUN-G_jnYUjfSoFdR-4R7ubvKOOoMJtPwTLTjT2W5LqUxVxO8Zj74kLRQz_6fEJXuTLj5vK9iUfSZhGmpAZ_mw6kSGTbdA)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. _**[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42ef16e3e31f42c5a246033cbed9d669&_e=UosCiiCShgaflbfayPQ1fyiqOrS3SsSL9MJXVhz9dJ5s1ixpJc-VZiBGz0NRgG4xsArclYQCuGHdJ0VLpIsuFKSGu1A2PLvsOeGxmXy9nSyttTJMV6VFN7FG_nklOqBFQPnfJLPDVVNCjJh-Cx5SN33LlSbJrw8flTrFdzs97KXE39639ept9PVETnpOUUAEbiOwGB0kcGy4nB4pJJbyq-hJgVPx-SZa-2-_DIzcl5T5mprfbnDltyFkWn59X2gUnQGUZNIz3-8PCn5f4BFI7SCig1FLvKD5mDZDhUhA8UCwYG5i27W3MdZItvUioOx4KZVa98X7TIB9T_Ka2IshwBkYP43F0Qd5QKEGlUSTDu8_d8KveNaQPUbMs6RnELyU)**_

It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back. With hope and thanks, Kimberly Bretches P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit. And remember –Blue Lives Matter! © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303

We noticed a thread from the Senate Judiciary Democrats that was worth sharing.
#

Friends -
Yesterday we sent an email on why Kash Patel as the head of the ATF is so dangerous, but we thought it was important to expand on that thought.
We noticed a thread from the Senate Judiciary Democrats that was worth sharing.
Please read it below and if you understand why our work to organize, educate, and persuade people and politicians about why gun safety legislation will save lives, make a contribution of any amount to GIFFORDS today.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb25.m4Qwdn&refcode=em250226-1-b&t=1&akid=10047%2E3935704%2ELnOBcW)
This is the key:
**"ATF can sabotage background check systems and stonewall investigators trying to get to the bottom of violent crime."**
95% of Americans support background checks for gun purchases, but that is something Republicans have been fighting against -- and many even believe is unconstitutional.
Without a strong background checks program, criminals will have easier access to firearms. Keeping an eye on this issue is something we have to be vigilant about. And if Kash Patel acts to weaken background checks, we need to spring into action. Because very few Americans want that.
[**If you agree that protecting our background checks system is important, please make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS today. We are fighting every day to make our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb25.m4Qwdn&refcode=em250226-1-b&t=2&akid=10047%2E3935704%2ELnOBcW)

I have long said that in the United States we do not suffer from a lack of resources for those in need, we suffer because we cannot satisfy billionaire greed.
Last night House Republicans voted to gut Medicaid and slash food and housing assistance for millions, just to hand trillions in tax cuts to 800 billionaires and billion dollar corporations. All this while America already leads the developed world in infant and maternal mortality,1 lowest life expectancy,2 and the highest levels of wealth and income inequality.3 This Republican bill will further exacerbate each of these crises. This bill is not about fiscal responsibility. It is about cruelty and concentrating power in the hands of the ultra-rich at the expense of everyday Americans. Below I share what's in this bill, it's current status, and one important call to action you can take to help block it in the Senate. **Let 's Address This.**

## What's in This Bill?
In a 217-215 vote, Republicans near unanimously (Thomas Massie of Kentucky voted with Democrats against this bill) proclaimed to all Americans that they serve 800 billionaires and a few hundred billion dollar corporations--not the 330 million Americans who elected them.
**Here is what is in this horrific piece of legislation:**
**❌ Medicaid Cuts -** The bill slashes Medicaid. Medicaid covers 60 million Americans, funds 41% of all births in the U.S., and pays for 63% of nursing home care. Cutting Medicaid will force hospitals to close, leave seniors and disabled people without care, and deny millions of children access to life-saving medical treatment, and devastate rural hospitals, which are already struggling to stay open. Remember, 9 of the top 10 states most dependent on federal welfare are Republican states. Slashing Medicaid will hurt them the most.
**❌ Food Cuts -** The bill severely guts the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which 41 million Americans rely on to feed their families, and guts free school lunches. This means more children sitting in class hungry, going to bed hungry, more food banks overwhelmed, and more families forced into impossible choices between rent and groceries. Again, 9 of the top 10 states with the highest levels of poverty are Republican states. Slashing food access will hurt them the most.
**❌ Housing Cuts -** The bill guts initiatives to help working Americans afford housing. Rather than pass legislation expanding funding for affordable housing, Republicans have further exacerbated the housing crisis at a time when homelessness is at record highs in modern times. Given that Americans need to earn 88% more now than just in 2020 to afford a home, this bill will further increase the homelessness crisis in this country.
**✅ $4.5 Trillion in Tax Cuts for Billionaires & Corporations -** While working people suffer cuts to healthcare, food, and housing, billionaires enjoy cuts to their already low taxes. At a time when working families are struggling, this bill hands the wealthiest Americans trillions of more dollars while defunding essential services people need to live. Remember, after the 2017 Trump tax cut of $2.1T, billionaires and massive corporations paid the lowest effective tax rate of any demographic. Now with a proposed $4.5T Trump tax cut for billionaires, this injustice will become even worse.
In short, this is not just a bad bill--it is a violent attack on working-class and vulnerable Americans. If it passes the Senate, millions will lose their healthcare, children will go hungry, homelessness will increase, and people will die so the richest in this country can buy another yacht or private jet.

### What You Can Do: Call Your Senators Now
This bill is not law yet. It still has has to pass the Senate. That means that before it gets there, the Senate must hear from all of us--loudly and clearly--that we will not stand by while they strip healthcare and food assistance from millions.
📞 Call your senators today--Republican or Democrat. Demand that they vote NO. You can find their contact information here: [Senate Directory](https://substack.com/redirect/fc4398d3-e595-46d5-b855-d2d5808ba58d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
#### Script to Use When Calling Your Senators
_"Hello, my name is [Your Name], and I am a constituent from [Your City/State]. I am calling to demand that Senator [Last Name] vote NO on the House bill that cuts Medicaid and food assistance while giving $4.5 trillion in tax breaks to billionaires. This bill will take healthcare away from millions of Americans, increase child hunger, and devastate working families --just so the wealthiest corporations can pay even less in taxes. This is unacceptable. I urge you to publicly oppose this bill and commit to voting against it. Please do the right thing and stand with the people you were elected to serve. Thank you."_
**Remember -- Members of Congress are required to document the numbers of calls they get and the issues they get called about.** Let's flood their phone lines and overwhelm them with opposition to this barbaric piece of legislation.
[Give a gift subscription](https://substack..gFYccMht6ipv1WRSmy6YT6bM6Jfe4jwMQaxX5X9Vpr4?&gift=true)
## Conclusion
As I've said before, from the perspective of us working Americans, this is not a MAGA vs Liberal, or Republican vs Progressive battle. This is class warfare of the billionaire elite against the rest of us. Do not buy into the culture wars, and instead stand united in this class war that threatens to deny hundreds of millions of Americans the basic healthcare, food, and housing access we need to live.
We cannot allow a system where 330 million Americans suffer so 800 billionaires can hoard even more wealth. We have the power to stop this--but only if we take action. Call your senators. Share this article. Spread the word. Demand justice. Fight back.

Dear friend, You may have heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Tucker Carlson, or any one of a dozen podcasts that have been willing to hear my story.I’ve spent years fighting to stop LGBTQ+ activists from “transitioning” my 12-year-old son against my will. It started ten years ago when my ex-wife claimed our 2-year-old son, James, wanted to become a girl. Thanks to Tucker Carlson and Ken Paxton we were able to get a law passed banning sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, But the Trans lobby helped my ex-wife kidnap my son James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state.Predictably, a radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave her the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life.But when President Trump signed his executive order protecting children from transgender mutilation surgeries, I thought my son might be safe.Unfortunately Trump’s executive order was immediately blocked by another one of these Leftist, Pro-LGBT, judges.

## Ukraine, U.S. Agree on Minerals Deal
Ukraine and the U.S. reached [a framework agreement Tuesday on a minerals](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O8yAQAJ_G7rBgjSEuKL4mXb72Smttlngv-EdAgvL2p1x__WhGmq_bdEOOvN__40auhGMCCYOQIMBMHjm-J916F4iA-pacsloOl9EY3a4OZ3ux_bJcAs6jx7EPqPQ8KlJ-kP0wt-w-NglglJVW2k4FCHqZRz3LBRevGy3JczlS933wXlYK8X28KHXLsbXRraWcuen_NXBt4Fpr7XaquRI9PkADV3_sGL0o6bmdIpfED8oiYSJBmMoqNt4pYczCE0bxfCTknQTI3iht2uT8WTlGzsY2Wt435PhbLn-deDn4CQAA__-UAWI5) deal that grants the U.S. greater access to Ukraine’s vast mineral reserves, including rare earth elements like lithium and semiconductor-grade neon gas. However, [negotiations continued](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn8N3ojwBWM8MHTxlq4drQsc8TUYIkwS5d9XqdSx66dPT0_v67SckBPnyydu5FosCygYpAIJZgnI6bXoLrhIBHTsyPWjVoOdjNHd6iYLvbFmovPQazsMkbwPGq226M0QsWP3pikA049qVOOhjxC1P0_6rDz6oIVWFLiVevgunNtKMb3Kg-rBl61Lbm3ttovjh4BZwHx98YNzoBvlQLm9PwLm-7UiZ5JPrDJho73Jv-m-y0roV4mXSrRRbrJkuXGmimmXgTAJmLvqwu3JKfFuRqHVZUNOvwLtvyAPBz8BAAD__zNJZVU) over whether these mineral revenues would repay past U.S. military and economic aid or only support future assistance. Security guarantees for Ukraine and the extent of U.S. decision-making power over resource management also remain unresolved. One key part of the deal calls for a fund where Ukraine allocates half of the revenue from future state-owned resource projects—such as oil, gas, and infrastructure—for domestic development. Ukrainian President Volodymyr [Zelensky is expected to visit Washington](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1y6yAQQOGngU6e1QqBXVDcRp1vm1KDxMpswo9HYHuUp884feoz8xXn4zpfHUfOt_8ukW1bmRFw7AA71LN3HI9ZSW83IqRBku2NgvF80VrJYM9muaiNAMxqwONAC-I6oDH9OGrvB8n2rQGi7g0YMKd-w02ty0UtsLrVK6GAPLeynz4L5xZoi0d50n5aS5LRhtbuVQz_BE4CpxYocIzvJnAKJVGmVxU4OZ84c227a1yywGns9XAesWv7I927b4qU69fRvQI36kJ5VBI4yd36-4tj5KqNUHBLjn9x2f4a8bT4EwAA___2ImBV) soon to finalize and sign the agreement with President Trump.
## Federal Judges Block Variety of Trump Policies
Federal judges across the country on Tuesday blocked key Trump administration policies, issuing rulings that challenge executive [actions on federal funding](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8GNiJ8xmAPDF28pWtH6wxHTItDRM6p0q-v0r3zk96T3sd5OWMu-Xp5x508p7qAhkFpUGCXiLk8FyOjT0RAvSTfOaOHcbLWyM3biDYaHJNzPWk3RTdNqzVjD6Ob0KLM_mXTALZz2ml36hIkE9bJrDpgiEYYTTFzbafPmq-8USrP-qB2CnWXxW_Mt7vo3wTMAmbeaMulvJiAudHlKMi5XgXMoR6N1YrMhe4C5qGz_WB6xe3YbypRpIZFYY4qNaIfUmup4YuigFk2H2_fuZR8t04Yfdkx_zUk__fj4eE3AAD__6x3YnY), foreign aid, and refugee admissions. In Washington, D.C., a federal judge appointed by former President Biden indefinitely halted a directive seeking to freeze trillions in federal grants and loans, citing its sweeping impact. Also on Tuesday in Seattle, another Biden-appointed judge blocked Trump’s executive order [suspending refugee admissions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDHv2yAUxD8N3ojwM8bxwJCq8tR06dAxwvBw3r8YLMBx009fuZ3_20mnu9P9ft4fd0OB4vLdrKirTw8Q0HMBHNTDGQrvh2yc9oiAXYO6HaTor6NSsnlqNc-DAoHYdt6PeB16nHsjRjD9eL0a1ZA-2wSAagcxiOHSevDSzqOchTXWSSYFOqopXz4SxfpEH97phfli09oE_ax1K6y7MZgYTMdxXNYST4_BhJHvhcG0pUCV7CmXMxpXjJXB9LG7Bfkckv1VeM37uvHC8TfavdILecoOMy972TA6igvP6PcFkRu3UimUYuE18frE_zMm89ut_XPvviHrpmTJse7rlxMcHuUH5q3J2m0HhUBFDUyKZTUU_v2on3F9afgbAAD___uiffw), arguing it exceeded presidential authority and contradicted congressional mandates. The administration also faced legal [setbacks on foreign aid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LHOnDAQBOCnMZ2RWYz5KVxEiej-K9KkRMZec3sC-2TvHbq3j0ifbqSRPo3mz_fy7WintN3cgZZjXkDBIBVIMEtwtH8W3QQbEQH7Bm03ajV8Tcbo5m7XIUzdOnQxjhpH07svCGEyflVGd6imhuylKQDTjWpUY9tFiNqvk16Vdz5ooRUG4lzaR6bEd4z7J7-xtD4fzW7vzM8q-h8CZgHzeZ6tX2vCs169gPmKAubHK2woX9VRkJUdowz4dIUPTCxjLkhbkq5WquySRxlfKVDapM-Ji_OcS5VbcYkvTPQzJfYURP_r5-23VJ1UBvqm2PA8ad-pmlFotR2O9n8z-X-3vS38DQAA__8sinFg), with an Obama-appointed judge ordering the State Department and USAID to comply with a previous restraining order and pay outstanding invoices to contractors.

Here's a [list of current court cases facing the Trump administration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2P2zAMhn-NvDFQaMWKBw8pCk-9Lh06BrJEO7zThyHJMdJfXzj7TXxAgi_wPn8_7h-GPcfltwk01DndUeIFJAJ2d2fYv-6qccNMhNQ2NJy1kpdr33WqeQwKreqn_mqvUmqtJ9TUXnvda5oNdhdqeDjSJGJ31lJLfTrPOCs79WqS1linhJLkuKZ8-kwc64Nm_0pPyiebQuOHR61rEe1N4Chw3Pf9FEo8bgJHirAVgeOaPFe2By7HawwUq8DxQZmgwP6eNW9hBRMdhK18gckEO8fIcXkvfSoHcgSbtlzhc3MLweST_SqQad4WIjAucCmcIkwmChxNhtvt_O9Xeo6iHZNlJ9qfPw6VtJc_lNcmD27d2XsunRZKLsGwfzer35l-Dvg_AAD__2g_g80).
## $1 Million Retirement: How Long It Lasts by State
A new list shows that [$1 million in retirement savings](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQRp_GdIPsiflJ4eI2dLntlmjA4zArgxF2gnj7Vbbf_vuOjs7XY3yQRNme_2llV0IaUWMDGgHb0ZPEa7SVd4EZ-VaxM53VTX9vW1stzvSdCYSM1DeW-ibcaUJir7XXNzPrStyHphFb0-lOd7UJGOw83e2kZ5q9VVazl5KO-jvJVhYO8UpvPuo5rVV0Syl7Vrd_CgeFw3me9Vvyi-JMuxSKkstnqHBYad_Zw5JOCHSAgVVilLTBk0uGK71ANji4yMErbwWmC16QIRcqrHCoDuf383PJbaesfq4k8deh_NXk7fAnAAD__0eXZek) would last less than 20 years in Hawaii, California, and Massachusetts but over 75 years in Arkansas, Mississippi, and West Virginia. Rankings were based on $1 million in retirement savings, [Social Security benefits](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdEbL4tikcPE3dPnbK5Gxl-CTwZG9BOXtT1x_3SeN5tNovh7Tw8UU9-d_t5HlJU8IeJOAEvUUXEyfSTXBLkRIfUO2Mwpuw11r1azWD3OADgicMYDUd0OvvJ-xu2sYjNFNtJcNEHVnwIBpuwUX5ee7msE7H5RQQCFyLu13jjuvtKRPflNpfd6aZFfmVxX9P4GjwPE8z9bvs79CgeOlFjgCXnzRUWVlx1TluVIhucWUYt5lyCm5UmU59irzwXJxlamyLMSx0EY7tytvqSk2vM6rVLURCp6bi-l3Cf_1zNviTwAAAP__2FBlrA), and essential living costs, including groceries, housing, utilities, transportation, health care, and other expenses. **FOX & Friends Features
Breakthrough Solar
Generator** _**Demand Is Surging – 107,000 Americans
Have Already Claimed Theirs...**_
---
[](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20470/6374453/9da3d8820701d8161d283898f59796106384a570/815b818fdcde4f6418b93fe605f05edb2dc72a12)
---
FOX & Friends featured a breakthrough solar generator right before a "polar vortex" sent thousands of Americans into total darkness. Skip Bedell recommended it as the perfect gift to prepare for winter storms. **_And then BOOM!_** _**Demand surged and 4Patriots sold out.**_ Days later, a massive ice storm hit the nation. The folks who were fortunate enough to claim their silent, fume-free solar generator were thanking their lucky stars. Because despite power outages, rolling blackouts and bone-chilling temperatures... Those who acted fast and got their [**4Patriots solar generator**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20470/6374453/d523eed64258d24b2569cf45b2e2d912b2d55add/815b818fdcde4f6418b93fe605f05edb2dc72a12) had peace of mind and could power critical devices like lights, space heaters, communications, critical medical devices and even fridges and freezers. Sadly, those who didn't prepare were left to hope and pray the lights came back on soon. **But that's not why this generator is going viral...** **National Security Experts
Fear Imminent Threat To
Our Power Grid** Freak ice storms, hurricanes and raging wildfires aren't the only threat to our nation's crumbling power grid... Shockingly, in 2022 alone there were over 70 physical attacks on our nation's power grid! And even worse, attacks on just 9 of the nation's 55,000 electrical substations could trigger... **A nationwide blackout that could last up to 18 months!** A former CIA Director warned that an attack on America's infrastructure would, _"Blackout the national electric grid and other life-sustaining critical infrastructures for over a year. Killing 9 out of 10 Americans by starvation and societal collapse."_ Despite this clear and present danger... **Our Government Is
Woefully Unprepared** They ignore dire warnings from national security experts about our vulnerable power grid. Warnings of physical, electro-magnetic pulse (EMP) and cyberattacks... And who suffers because of their neglect? YOU and your family. **Imagine a blackout lasting not days, but weeks or months.** Your life would be frozen in time right at the moment your power fails. An entire country plunged into darkness. Without a generator, your fridge, electric range and microwave would be dead. All the food in your fridge and freezer – spoiled. Your well couldn't pump fresh water into your house. And even if you don't have a well, a total grid failure means no fresh water to drink, cook or clean with. This is not some crazy doomsday theory. It's a real threat. **That's why many Americans are taking matters into their own hands and are securing their own solar powered generator.** Solar generators are a smart choice because they produce an endless supply of life-saving electricity when you need it most – and **without gas, fumes or noise**. Our top recommendation in portable solar generators is the [**Patriot Power Generator**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20470/6374453/d523eed64258d24b2569cf45b2e2d912b2d55add/815b818fdcde4f6418b93fe605f05edb2dc72a12). **THIS breakthrough solar generator is safe enough to use inside. And never needs gas, ever.** And you'll have peace of mind knowing that you and your family have a safe, reliable and easy-to-use source of backup power. To survive a blackout, storm, grid-down event... or worse. It's why the Patriot Power Generator was recently featured on **Fox & Friends**... **And why over 107,000
Americans already have it
in their homes right now.** **Demand is surging...** _"It has a battery inside. You can charge it with electricity or – what's really cool – with a solar panel that comes with it for FREE."_ [**Click Here To See This Breakthrough Solar Generator In Action!**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20470/6374453/d523eed64258d24b2569cf45b2e2d912b2d55add/815b818fdcde4f6418b93fe605f05edb2dc72a12) To your survival,

Frank Bates
Patriot Headquarters P.S. Thanks to your support, we're able to provide support to important charities that help American veterans and their families. Charities like Fisher House, A Soldier's Child Foundation, Team Rubicon and Operation Homefront. **Customers Are
Raving About Their
Solar Generator** **Joe B.**
"My Patriot Power Generator arrived four days before Ian "the beast" hurricane hit my town. It was a lifesaver. After losing all power, we would have been in absolute darkness with no way to communicate to the outside world. If we needed aid or rescue, it would have been impossible with dead phone batteries. The Patriot Power Generator was everything you said it was and more. I say this with tears in my eyes: I'll never be without at least one. Great product, people! You should be proud!" **Bob A.**
"Could not be happier! Generator works flawlessly, solar works flawlessly, plus all the other goodies in the package are amazing! Would definitely recommend 4Patriots for all your generator and other survival needs! Just spoke with Sienna at customer service to say how much I love the products! Sienna was very courteous and professional!" **Carla U.**
"The ice storms in February left us without any type of electricity for a solid week. If it wasn't for the solar generator, my husband wouldn't have been able to sleep with his CPAP and we would have been in the dark for a week. It was very helpful and very convenient to be able to keep it charging continuously by day in the sun. It's well worth the money. Get off the fence and order this for the safety and security of your family!" **Bernice L.**
"Don't wait to add this vital piece of equipment to your preparedness arsenal! We were able to keep our lights on and our electronic equipment charged for 5 days when the power went out last year. As soon as we could, we purchased another generator!" **Patricia T.**
"This is great not just emergencies, but everyday help as well! I needed to repair my shed, but there's no power out there, and most of my tools are plug-in electric. I was unhappily thinking about running 150ft of extension cords, then remembered my 4Patriots Solar Generator! Worked like a charm. Utterly reliable and easy to use. There's no good reason to put off getting back-up power! Peace of mind and convenience, too! Love it!" **Angel H.**
"Just went through the winter storm. I absolutely love my generator. It is a life saver! We had three days of no power with below freezing temperatures. We have a 3-year old and a 75-year old to take care of, and their lives depend on my ability to provide. I hooked up TV and DVD players, and had small 250-watt heaters. I put the solar panels in the windows all day while our generator was in use. Even though there was no direct sunlight, the panels helped keep the generator charged. After three days, we still had a small charge on our generator while keeping my family entertained and warm enough not to shiver." **Sharon P.**
"Having this generator means I'm not stuck. 4Patriots is by far the best place to shop for your critical emergency needs! I have been a customer since 2017! It's better to be prepared than to start doing that crazy buying that people were doing, for instance, at the start of the pandemic." | | Peter, I grew up in a family with union roots that go back three generations. My father was a firefighter and from a very young age, he taught me that you have to work hard for everything — but you also have to hold the ladder so the next person has the opportunity to climb. **Those are the values I’ve carried with me my entire career in public service.** Before I became a member of Congress, I served in Oregon’s state legislature. I was elected to the position of Majority Leader and increased the state’s minimum wage, provided paid sick leave for workers, passed a first-in-the-nation requirement for health insurers to cover 12-month supplies of birth control, and more. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102820868/530370424/827090188?refcode=AU_VAH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250226_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmNmMzA1MC02N2Y0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hSlJX4ugPLm1Z7zVZy-yUtvONFfBum7ieRldObFbEPg=) I was then elected as Oregon’s Labor Commissioner in 2018. I worked hard to ensure workers were paid the wages and benefits that they earned, oversaw the enforcement of civil rights and housing discrimination protections for Oregonians, and fought to expand unemployment benefits during the pandemic. Now, I’m fighting the same fight in Congress to make a difference for working families and communities across Oregon. As a working mom, I’ve seen and experienced the struggles Oregon’s families face — and **I’m determined to stand up for families and work with anyone to pass common sense ways to bring prices down and drive wages up.** **[But I can’t do it alone, Peter. debilitating. We need to do something new and have a focal point besides
his Gotham City chaos. What can we DO as we refuse to succumb to the
attitude we are hearing from so many of defeatism? PLEASE share your ideas
for what we can do to build a different future.

I felt that.

Because the point of all this chaos — the headlines, the distractions, the
manufactured crises — is to make people feel powerless. To make people
check out.

But here’s what I told them: Let’s not wait until the midterms. Let’s find
races we can win right now. And that starts in Wisconsin.

Wisconsin’s Supreme Court race is flying under the radar, but the outcome
has implications for the future of democracy, voting rights, and abortion
access — across the country.

Elon Musk is already xeet-ing (?) about this race, and there’s no doubt he
and his MAGA billionaire buddies are going to flood the state with dark
money. They want to rig the election, stack the court with extremists, and
clear the way for even more attacks on our rights.

They want us to be so overwhelmed that we don’t show up. They want us to
feel like nothing we do will matter.

But Wisconsin has been decided by razor-thin margins for years — sometimes
just a few thousand votes. That means what we do right now actually
matters.

So here’s what we’re going to do:

📲 Text or call anyone you know in Wisconsin. Make sure they know this
election is happening.

name: Amy Acton
subject: Ohio deserves better than Vivek Ramaswamy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
I understand the struggles Ohioans face every day – unlike Vivek Ramaswamy
| | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T95fd5381-e5e7-43f7-96e9-7213592acef3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3029e8b8-82a8-4234-958f-12c12a78f37b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, it’s Amy Acton, candidate for Ohio Governor. I am an Ohio native, and I’ve spent my career giving back to the state that I grew up in. From serving as a nonprofit leader advocating for Ohio’s physical and economic well-being to guiding Ohioans through a once-in-a-lifetime public health crisis as the Director of the Department of Public Health during COVID-19, I have always worked to make life better for Ohioans. But my opponent, far-right Trump loyalist Vivek Ramaswamy has already shown that he will back Trump – even at the expense of Ohioans. He recently appeared on Fox News (of course) where he PRAISED Donald Trump’s “fast and furious” executive orders. For my opponent, these rapid changes are something to be “grateful” for – but he’s so out of touch with the reality of what Trump’s actions mean for Ohioans. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfb491f96-6e46-4864-b89a-4dc4230d80e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump is censoring critical information about health services and he has blocked the CDC from updating medical professionals about disease outbreaks. That’s going to hurt Ohio’s ability to be prepared for emergencies. Plus, he’s enacting massive tariffs that are going to have a devastating impact on the affordability of common goods. And Vivek Ramaswamy thinks Ohioans should be “grateful” for that? [Ohioans deserve a Governor who understands the issues that are impacting our state. That’s why my team and I set a goal to raise $25,000 so we can defeat Vivek Ramaswamy and stop an out-of-touch billionaire from “leading” Ohio. Can we count on you to help us hit our target by making a split contribution between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc0397bd-5354-49bf-b587-88b67615bb76/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [DONATE NOW →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf65188a2-e26f-4824-af60-ed7f44685bd6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Peter, Vivek Ramaswamy does not understand the struggles the average Ohioan faces every day – but I do. Growing up, my family experienced periods of homelessness. My brother and I often wondered where we were going to sleep at night or when our next hot meal would be – and I know what I experienced is the same painful reality for too many Ohioans. As Governor, I will NEVER turn my back on those in need. I will work head-on with people across party lines to make life better for all Ohioans – not just the wealthy and the powerful. [I will be the leader Ohio needs. So will you please split a contribution between my grassroots campaign and Blue Amp Action today so I can get the resources together that I’ll need to take on a billionaire like Vivek Ramaswamy?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0d73ad4e-d69e-44df-82a6-e273d2b541ea/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. Peter,

I recently introduced a bill in the U.S. Senate that would finally declare English as the official language of the United States.

It’s just common sense–but the radical left had a _meltdown_ , calling me a racist and a bigot.

But as one of the only naturalized citizens serving in the U.S. Senate, **I am here to tell you Americans don’t have to be ashamed of our culture.**

When I moved here legally with my family from Colombia at age five, I didn’t speak a word of English.

But I was determined to master the language because it was clear to me that this was the whole reason my family came here— _to become Americans._

**The proudest moment of my life was becoming an American citizen at age 18, a process that showed me just how foundational the English language is to the American way of life.**

It’s long past time that we enshrine this simple fact into law.

[**Where do you stand, Peter? [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/70756F655332783372636F454353396562687376694F485948735343712B763672586D4157707A676459726C636F6733786F6E2B526572766D6752546567474F/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-01-10%20at%208.23.20%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Hello! I’m Gay Valimont, candidate for Florida’s 1st Congressional District, and I need your help.
Hundreds of families are being affected by the current administration’s harmful policies, and we need to put an end to it.
As we face growing national security risks, including recent warnings from the CIA about escalating threats to the U.S., it’s clearer than ever that we need principled leadership in Congress —especially here in Florida’s 1st District.
Our community deserves a representative who prioritizes your safety, well-being, and future, rather than getting caught up in partisan distractions and scandals.
That’s why my campaign is so important. We need to rise above the chaos and focus on what truly matters to you: tackling gun violence, ensuring affordable healthcare, and supporting our farmers—who have seen their subsidies cut under the current leadership. Our district needs someone who will fight for your needs and not just their own.
My opponent is Super-PAC backed, Trump endorsed, and has his pockets lined with the GOP’s money, and wants to keep it that way. The Right is convinced they have already won, but with your help, we can prove them all wrong.
Your support is the defining factor for the health of our democracy. Rushing $8 to our campaign helps us takes steps in the right direction, and can stop the GOP from continuing its agenda. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/5354344C686744703565775737396A41567633726661474473444C56636F36343376616464372B4C364F784456725666616973552F532F4F455A7668484A5A47/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-02-12%20at%202.22.12%E2%80%AFPM.png]
For too long, the GOP has been more interested in defending its reputation than addressing the real issues facing our community. Their scandals and gamesmanship have left Northwest Florida behind, and we can’t afford another term of this dysfunction. The stakes are simply too high.
This campaign is about bringing accountability and service back to Congress. I am committed to working tirelessly for you—fighting for affordable healthcare, expanding economic opportunities, and securing a better future for every family in this district. We need leadership that doesn’t just talk but takes action.
Together, we can make a change. I am ready to lead with integrity, compassion, and a clear vision for a brighter future.
Thank you for your support. I know I can count on you!
Warm regards,
Gay Valimont

body:
Volunteer. And I mean that in the more traditional sense: give time to your neighbors and to organizations doing good work.

---
# [How to deal with your political angst](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=157699659&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU3Njk5NjU5LCJpYXQiOjE3NDA1OTU0OTMsImV4cCI6MTc0MzE4NzQ5MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.9-1xISy_FT9kPDn8S28pWYrxxPFzGGQc18-a1HCBq_I)
### Volunteer. And I mean that in the more traditional sense: give time to your neighbors and to organizations doing good work.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Feb 26
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvYmVuc2FtdWVscy9wL2hvdy10by1kZWFsLXdpdGgteW91ci1wb2xpdGljYWwtYW5nc3Q_.PaaSsfZaegzp1lutK3dYJFIVuvujpYfFCLA9gDgkWWA?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/how-to-deal-with-your-political-angst?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Given the writing I do in and around politics, for people I know socially, I've occasionally become their political therapist--what's _actually_ worrying vs. what's just a sensationalist headline, etc.
Needless to say, it has been a rough month. There is a lot to be worried about.
In this informal, unremunerated role as a political therapist, the question I've been getting most: "What can I be doing?"1
Having thought about this a bunch, my answer: **volunteer**. And I don't mean volunteer by knocking on doors for political candidates--that has its time and place. I mean helping neighbors and volunteering for organizations that do good work.
Why?
1. The most obvious: it's important and does good. If you are worried about the impact that our government is having, as I am, **this is a pretty direct way to counteract that.** This isn't resigning yourself to whatever is happening in Washington; to volunteer is to take a stand.
2. **Volunteering makes you[measurably happier and measurably more optimistic](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5ab87c-33b4-474f-99fa-1725d74e2dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. In a political landscape where there isn't a lot to feel great about, it will _literally_ make you feel better.
3. It's measurably [good for your health](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e5bff8-d0dd-469c-91af-5f9038113a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
4. In a moment where people feel lonelier and more disconnected than ever, it's a good way to build community and make friends.

Information on how to volunteer is at the [bottom of this email](https://substack.com/redirect/f1a737c4-19a2-4ff4-9b4f-d860872a2e30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Pledge your support](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.5TScIF6CMEFsqFhlxsHalLGCeQ_8JWVBwJ1nk227k5Q?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=157699659)
### The data on volunteering and charitable giving
The Census Bureau and AmeriCorps, I was surprised to learn, track how often Americans over the age of 16 [say that they volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/3dbb9326-bcff-42bc-a9cf-f024e2e22ec3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).2
* 54% say they informally volunteer (at least once per year): helping a neighbor with groceries, offering free childcare, etc.
* 28% say they formally volunteer through an organization (at least once per year).

[Volunteering peaked just after 9/11](https://substack.com/redirect/32bd87b2-0853-4c00-be26-89b3b852b6f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).3 It's been declining since then, and although it's [recovered from lows during the pandemic](https://substack.com/redirect/5bf90f4d-e5fe-4486-adb2-29df7757f8ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), rates are roughly flat over the last eight years or so.
Studies very consistently find that **[conservatives are more charitable than liberals](https://substack.com/redirect/5eff86bc-b740-4aae-8a6c-3c0e88472f2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ,4 a finding that should give liberals pause--and encourage them to find ways to get involved and volunteer.
### Volunteering makes you happier, healthier, and live longer
People are happier when they volunteer more; that's been reasonably well documented for a while now. The challenge, of course, is assessing causality: are people happier because they volunteer more? Or do they volunteer more because they're happier?
It turns out that volunteering--causally!--makes you happier,5 according to a [20-year-long longitudinal study](https://substack.com/redirect/08b7e1ad-b0d3-4bf3-8cb7-66886755f7b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).6 People who volunteer are also [more optimistic](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5ab87c-33b4-474f-99fa-1725d74e2dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The benefits extend to physical health too, and those who volunteer [live longer](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e5bff8-d0dd-469c-91af-5f9038113a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), were [less likely to develop high blood pressure](https://substack.com/redirect/60269415-df5c-4713-818e-a8615bbbef8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), have [decreased pain levels](https://substack.com/redirect/83ebfc79-5c5b-418b-81bf-4c908293c767?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [experience myriad other health benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/c8208595-eb35-4f1c-b766-b79979ffc379?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=157699659&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU3Njk5NjU5LCJpYXQiOjE3NDA1OTU0OTMsImV4cCI6MTc0MzE4NzQ5MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.9-1xISy_FT9kPDn8S28pWYrxxPFzGGQc18-a1HCBq_I)
### Volunteering builds community and makes people less lonely
Utah--which as I've written about, is a [real outlier when it comes to all sorts of community-oriented outcomes](https://substack.com/redirect/f3dd09d7-cfff-4a78-8433-c3b85050a301?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has [by far the highest rates of volunteering of any state in the country](https://substack.com/redirect/3dbb9326-bcff-42bc-a9cf-f024e2e22ec3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On the flipside, [Nevadans help their neighbors at the lowest rate in the country](https://substack.com/redirect/3dbb9326-bcff-42bc-a9cf-f024e2e22ec3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). What's also notable about Nevada: [only 27.2% of Nevadans were born in Nevada](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7cc967-7c21-4593-a81e-52a7a1ce50b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), by far the lowest of any state.7
I've written about the [crisis of loneliness](https://substack.com/redirect/8c81d521-8657-4d2e-963b-9cba5027c24b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before--it is one of the most pressing issues of our time.8 And it is no accident that [Nevada is the loneliest state in the country](https://substack.com/redirect/7bcc5fec-80fc-492c-8fc1-106ed60c4009?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at least by one measure.9 Obviously, lower rates of volunteerism aren't the sole reason for that, but a lack of community--which ties into that lack of volunteerism--is a clear contributing factor.
It turns out that [volunteering is a great way to meet people](https://substack.com/redirect/12bc77b2-6af0-49de-a78e-1d0cb6c40284?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)10 who share your interests, values, and desire to do good. And sure enough, people who volunteer are [less lonely](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5ab87c-33b4-474f-99fa-1725d74e2dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): volunteers are 29% less likely to say that they're disconnected from their friends.
### Volunteering _does_ matter
This comes from a [really terrific article in ](https://substack.com/redirect/bf461c54-850b-467a-a1a0-19a905a4eeed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Vox](https://substack.com/redirect/bf461c54-850b-467a-a1a0-19a905a4eeed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ by [Rachel Cohen](https://substack.com/redirect/9aa940b2-1be2-4661-9bd1-1d655887d3bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Last fall, a reader asked me what they could really do, as one person, to aid people living on the streets. "I often feel helpless to enact change," they wrote...
> My mind immediately went to systemic solutions, like voting for candidates who prioritize building more housing, or supporting efforts to loosen zoning codes.
> But when I called experts, their answers surprised me. Some of our ideas overlapped, but [many of their suggestions](https://substack.com/redirect/440d5631-085e-42eb-8e63-0359a5da9b7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were ones I had admittedly not entertained: **passing out socks or hand-warmers, donating items like sleeping bags to local shelters, or giving office supplies and bus passes to nonprofits serving unhoused people**.
Cohen's article--that for too many of us, charitable beliefs are a proper substitute for charitable giving and charitable deeds--is worth reading.
I'm not saying that agitating for policy change is unimportant; it's very important. But giving back has an immediate and direct impact in a way that even good policy cannot. The [overwhelming majority of nonprofit leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5ba1a0-e8f5-4e73-93ec-7bf6e11fde31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) say that **volunteers improve the quality of their services and programs**.
Americans donate five billion hours of their time per year--the [equivalent of $167 billion in value](https://substack.com/redirect/726d5f27-e7c0-47d1-b0b1-1d649a63b812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It may not be enough, but that's pretty extraordinary.
### How to volunteer
The simple answer: what are the causes you care about most? Reach out to those organizations; that survey I just mentioned (that found that most nonprofit leaders rely on volunteers) also [say that they have far too few](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5ba1a0-e8f5-4e73-93ec-7bf6e11fde31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If you need help figuring out where to go, [VolunteerMatch](https://substack.com/redirect/eec5d3fe-f723-428a-b856-4e91e9217e67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a great place to start. Beyond that:
* For those of you in St. Louis, the [United Way Volunteer Center](https://substack.com/redirect/2c194cf6-e0b3-4630-a646-6a6abebc313d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a good resource. I thought [r/StLouis](https://substack.com/redirect/a3f58926-2205-4533-b60d-e378194deb6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had two good threads too: [this Reddit thread](https://substack.com/redirect/eeea7db9-e406-48bd-a52a-55e10a3abe1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [this separate Reddit thread](https://substack.com/redirect/1609da30-bab6-4bbe-bcf5-10b19e7e3a49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* For those of you elsewhere, reach out to local organizations you know and care about. [This ](https://substack.com/redirect/7f9dd088-5f44-46a0-b602-b628f300f8e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[AP](https://substack.com/redirect/7f9dd088-5f44-46a0-b602-b628f300f8e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ article](https://substack.com/redirect/7f9dd088-5f44-46a0-b602-b628f300f8e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has some good guidance. And as above, searching your city's local subreddit isn't a bad place to look either.

I'll speak for myself: I used to volunteer more and then fell off during the pandemic. I'm [not alone in that regard](https://substack.com/redirect/3dbb9326-bcff-42bc-a9cf-f024e2e22ec3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but at this point it's a flimsy excuse--the pandemic started five years ago now.11
**There 's only so much I can do to change what's happening in national politics. But this is something that can make a difference and make all of us feel better about the world and our communities.**
I cannot think of a more worthy use of your time, or mine.
[Pledge your support](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.5TScIF6CMEFsqFhlxsHalLGCeQ_8JWVBwJ1nk227k5Q?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=157699659)

1
Often with an expletive thrown in there, I'll note.
2
The polling methodology was surprisingly difficult to track down. (I'll tell you why I cared so much about the methodology in a moment.) I went from [USAFacts.org](https://substack.com/redirect/137506a2-8c39-4850-8e17-89011c58c8c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [this AmeriCorps page](https://substack.com/redirect/85e5a502-d7bd-4b2b-8905-c12361e3ac4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a [Census Bureau page](https://substack.com/redirect/67b07ee7-bd51-4024-83a8-76b44467acd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that directed me straight back to an [AmeriCorps PDF](https://substack.com/redirect/053dde5a-e555-496e-a402-f8b90b223cf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) where I found this footnote: "For methodological details, please see the full technical documentation and frequently asked questions about the CEV at data.americorps.gov." It all started feeling a little bit like [this ](https://substack.com/redirect/043d9850-a133-4dee-bf17-0fb7a9e34b7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[xkcd](https://substack.com/redirect/043d9850-a133-4dee-bf17-0fb7a9e34b7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ :
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/043d9850-a133-4dee-bf17-0fb7a9e34b7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But hey, the data must be in that FAQ...right? Nope. The AmeriCorps' data page doesn't even have an FAQ! Down the rabbit hole I went. Eventually, after _way_ more searching than it warranted, I finally [found the methodology page](https://substack.com/redirect/32a2c714-0bc8-47b6-b9f7-df56e4d52c04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (Note that opening this link will automatically download a 224-page document from AmeriCorps.)
Why go through 45 minutes of trouble to find this? Because I was curious whether their data was observed or self-reported. Here's the answer, on p. 9: "The September 2023 Civic Engagement and Volunteering Supplement attempted to obtain self-responses from household members 16 years old and over."
It matters that people self-reported because I think people likely inflate the amount of volunteering they do for the same reason we inflate [how many times per week we floss](https://substack.com/redirect/adf9575c-1205-43a6-b6bd-a9ef7b5a0fe9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to our dentists: it's the answer we know we _should_ give, even if it's not totally true.
There isn't any better data out there, but I bring all of this up to say:
* All of this data should probably be taken with a grain of salt. With that said, if questions are consistently asked over time, it's probably still a good measure of change.
* I've complained about government data before, and I'm sure I will again. With that said: the [last time I complained about government data](https://substack.com/redirect/d2567ee2-ea67-49c0-aa3e-98a8f322ae79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I asked them to fix it and they did so within about 24 hours. So that was impressive and nice to see.

3
This data was first tracked, in earnest, going back to the '70s, so the spike in volunteering around 9/11 is the highest in at least the last 50 years or so.
4
Some of this, though not all of it, [may be attributable to things like religiosity](https://substack.com/redirect/5eff86bc-b740-4aae-8a6c-3c0e88472f2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and therefore how much people donate to religious causes (including tithing). But that doesn't account for everything.
It should also be noted, [according to one recent study](https://substack.com/redirect/1093242d-dea8-4f15-81ed-d0b513531d78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "We find that stronger religiosity increases volunteering toward individuals in their faith group (in-group). However, conservative beliefs reduce volunteering toward causes outside of an individual's faith community (out-group)."
So it's not without its issues, clearly, but I'm comfortable nonetheless saying that more volunteering is better than less volunteering, even with these caveats.
5
There are different theories for why that is (one involving the [reward pathway in your brain being triggered when you do good deeds](https://substack.com/redirect/b17e3b24-008b-4344-a585-538b75f1ccc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), but doing something good that makes you feel happier is a compelling combo.
6
More accurately, it finds that people who volunteer tend to be happier to begin with _and_ become even happier when they volunteer. Even still, that's pretty cool. (h/t to _The Washington Post_ for referring me to this study from [this article](https://substack.com/redirect/e4f12683-d14a-4c44-9b54-87a9619689bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
7
_The New York Times_ ran an [analysis on this back in 2014](https://substack.com/redirect/e21197fb-9318-4549-b973-f48ab8f459b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but once again, pulling more recent data was surprisingly difficult--I had to manually work through a [pretty-challengingly-formatted Census spreadsheet](https://substack.com/redirect/9716dd18-60d2-4583-aa26-419a3777914a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to get this.
By the way, if you're curious:
* Louisiana has the highest percentage of its residents born in-state: 77%.
* 65% of Missourians were born in Missouri, the 14th-highest of any state in the country.
* 57% of Americans were born in the state they live in today.

So Nevada is _way_ an outlier on all of this.
8
The percentage of people born in-state who live in-state is a _highly_ inexact way of getting at whether someone has community or not. Lots of transplants build incredible communities, and of course lots of people who live in their hometowns are lonely.
But it's one of the easier ways to look at this, and I don't necessarily think it's an accident that Nevada is at the bottom of both.
9
How you define loneliness is pretty challenging, so this is just one way of looking at it. Different people come to different conclusions by defining loneliness in different ways and weighting different measures. Some, of course, just make it up entirely. But the definition I used was backed by at least _some_ data.
10
Just to be clear: this is about meeting friends, despite what Google thinks you have in mind when you're asking about meeting people while volunteering:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b6f29271-3011-473f-ae53-487c58ff090e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
(By the way, if you're wondering, the internet seems to think... [yeah, maybe it is](https://substack.com/redirect/b441a3a0-aa58-4616-8af5-d277b317fb21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
11
Fourth graders at the beginning of the pandemic are in high school now. And that definitely makes me feel old... It's wild that it's been five years--it _still_ messes with my sense of time.
